summary.text: Michelle Bos-Lun is a Democratic state representative from Vermont's Windham-3 District who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. An educator, she served on the Corrections and Institutions Committee.

paragraphs.text: Michelle Bos-Lun was born in Waukesha, Wisconsin, and earned a bachelor's degree from Beloit College in 1987 and a master's degree from the School for International Training in 2005.
Her career experience includes working as a re-entry coordinator at a community justice center, an educator, a human services worker, a youth program director and a housing case manager.
She has served as volunteer co-director of the Bihar Educational Change Foundation, as a volunteer educator with the National Alliance for Mental Illness, and as chair of Monadnock Friends of Tibet.
Bos-Lun assumed office in the Vermont House on January 4, 2023, and was assigned to the Corrections and Institutions Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
